loadedStaleCount: {loaded} records retained from an earlier read. Current totals are unavailable.
requestsStale: Access requests could not be refreshed. Retained records are from an earlier read; retry before reviewing.
requestsReadUnavailable: Access requests are unavailable. This is not an empty request list.
rosterReadUnavailable: The directory roster could not be read. Retry without changing identity configuration.
referenceBoundary: Without a directory observation, only the server-verified current principal is shown. Requests do not prove current roles or identity activity.
requestRecorded: Access request {id} recorded. This does not change provider membership.
reviewRecorded: Review for {id} recorded. Provider membership and effect verification remain separate.
reasonLength: {count} / 2000 characters. Use at least 20 non-padding characters.
filterRoster: Filter the displayed roster by name, email or subject ID
requestSearch: Search loaded requests by person or request ID
loadedMatches: {count} matches among {loaded} loaded records ({total} server records). Filters cover loaded records only.
noMatchingRequests: No loaded requests match these filters.
fdaiOwnerNotAssigned: FDAI Owner access is not assigned
tenantAdminDistinction: Azure subscription, Entra tenant, or application administrator status does not grant FDAI access. User management requires the FDAI Owner App Role in the current verified token.
ownerRecoveryHint: Assign the FDAI Owner App Role through the tenant identity-administration process, then sign out and back in so the new token carries the role. The Console cannot self-elevate.
directoryNotObserved: No authoritative directory observation is available in this process.
proposalOnlyHint: The console records a governed request and an independent review. Approval alone does not change Entra membership.
promotionRequiredHint: Only the promoted allowlisted executor may apply and independently verify group membership.
findUser: Find a user by email or name
roleRequestWorkflowApply: The protected identity workflow applies membership
roleRequestWorkflowVerify: A fresh directory read verifies the effect
roleRequestHint: This records a governed access request. It does not add the person or change Entra membership.
requestLifecycleHint: Approve or reject the request here. An approved request remains assignment pending until a separate protected workflow applies and verifies the Entra group change.
